text: Loved this place! Very clean, great service, food was delicious and fairly priced. We will be back when we are in the St Louis area again!!
Delicious. Limited variety of dumplings and dim sum, but great variety of menu selections. It is Cash only, but there is an ATM on premise. Quick service.

First timer. Our meal was not very good, and there were six of us. Everything was cold. The potatoes were soggy and the French toast was dry. The cinnamon roll was also dry and the cream cheese icing had actual chunks of cream cheese. The eggs took so long to come out that we cancelled them. They ended up arriving and were actually the only hot thing on the table. Expressed all of this to one manager, he didn't seem to care much but told us he would take the eggs off the bill (only). When he forgot to do that we asked for it to be corrected. The restaurant GM came up and apologized and fixed that and removed the cinnamon roll and eggs. Not worth the 80$ bill it still was. Will not be going back.

We knew the place was a bit eclectic but it wasn't at all what we expected. The first desk and valet people are really nice. The hotel is run down --- dirty tile in the shower, very dark carpet and musty. Their gym was just plain dirty --- old ratty equipment.  We ask for a safe to be put in the room for 3 days before one appeared. Our entire wing didn't have ice so you had to call for it to be brought to the room or you had to go to the other side of the hotel. The floors creaked with every step --- I mean EVERY step. If you get up in the middle of the night to use the bathroom there is no way to not wake up your spouse. Our room was haunted --- we were woken up by a loud rattle our last night which we hadn't heard before. Our friends stayed in the room beside us and they heard the loud rattle every night from 3am - 6am .....when they checked out the receptionist said it's the "Lafayette Shuffle" --- WTH !!! Our nephew spend a night in on the other side of the hotel and their bathroom light kept coming on and waking them up. Definitely not a place I would stay ever again.

If youve been to one wharf restaurant you've been to them all. Sitting up there, I could have been in Santa Cruz, i could have been at cannery row, I could have even have been on some lackluster New Jersey pier. 

The prices matches the industry- high tourist rip offs. 

The real issue was the fish through. We got the fisherman's platter. It was inedible. The fish was actually the worst fish I've ever had. I'm surprised we didn't get sick. It smelled like a can of tuna. 
I did eat the fries. A potato will rarely break your heart. 

I was also expecting an ocean sunset.... but apparently I was a little turned around and miscalculated the directions. 

We went to Safeway and got a carvel Ice cream cake. We ate most of it while watching the home shopping network. It was better food and entertainment than dinner.

Forever disappointed at this restaurant. The only reason to come here is because it's on campus. My last 4 visits have resulted in:
-dirty glasses with someone else's lipstick
-a drink with at least 4 bugs in it
-wilted and brown lettuce in a salad
-charred hamburgers that were ordered medium 

This is my last visit. That's enough chances to get your crap together, Scotty's. Unless I'm unable to leave because I'm stuck to your gross-ass floor.

Fantastic food! Generous and gracious proprietors. The lamb shank was delicious and you should try it even if you "don't like lamb". The masala sauce was creamy, spicy and amazing. The Turkish coffee was thick, not acidic, and actually gave me a buzz. Thanks for the wonderful time!

Mr. B's is an atmosphere that feels formal without feeling stuffy if you know what I mean.  You do not need to be wearing a coat and tie, but the staff will be, and they'll be serving food fit for a coat and tie establishment.  A really nice touch was there was a partially open kitchen here, so we could see our entrees being prepared.

Both Chas and I ordered the house specialty, the BBQ Shrimp!  Ironically this dish has quite literally nothing to do with BBQ whatsoever.  This is a sauteed head-on shrimp dish that has a major amount of butter with some Worcestershire and cracked black pepper throughout.  This velvety butter broth is seriously divine and I used probably half a loaf of their house baked bread just soaking up the remains once I was done with the shrimp.  The shrimp themselves were cooked absolutely perfectly and were covered in more than enough sauce.  This dish is so serious that the servers will come around and put a paper bib on you prior to serving the dish to be sure your clothing is protected.  He did not ask...he just did.  One second I was thanking him for bringing it over, the next he was tying it behind my head.

I am not someone who typically sucks out the remains of the shrimp once I peel off the head...but today I was.  I didn't want to pass on any of this insanely flavorful broth!!  I sucked out the heads, the tails, sucked on the outside of the shell...I didn't care one bit.  I probably looked to other tables like a homeless person having their fi

Today was my husband's birthday and I wanted to surprise him with a special restaurant.  His family is from Spain and he spent years living there also.  He wanted authentic Spanish so I chose Bulla Gastrobar after seeing them on TV.  We were NOT disappointed.  First, our server Andrea went above and beyond in 5 star service.  She directed him to a wine he would enjoy and our food was brought out hot, plates cleaned away quickly and always smiled.  The FOOD was true to form.  From the oxtails to the Patatas Bravas, to the tomato bread with PERFECT avocado slices, to the mussels, Pintxos, cannelloni just like his mother's, everything tasted just like SPAIN!!!  My husband left with a big smile.  Not only was the food good, but the cooks told him Happy Birthday too!  GREAT CREW/GREAT FOOD....a gem in Tampa Bay and we will be back!!!!

Wow. Makes me so very sad. We used to LOVE this location but it has changed so much. I miss the old experience when the orders were always right and the staff was trained to offer proper customer service. For the last two years we have been coming to this location and, up until about a two months ago, we loved it. There have been rare mistakes in the past and I have usually called to let someone know. Not to complain, but to genuinely let them know what happened in case a process is breaking down etc. To be honest I wasn't even mildly annoyed but any of the previous issues. 

I have had managers offer free food gift cards but have turned down the offer because it wasn't about that. They offered an apology, said they would discuss it with their team and everyone was happy. I just call to let them know so they can see where the breakdown was and make sure it doesn't happen for the next guest. And it was VERY rare to have a mistake.

But the last FOUR times we have eaten here they have messed our order up in some way, each time. The last three times I tried to tell them a sandwich was missing, then one of the chicken sandwiches was pink inside and felt like was dumped in a glass of water. The breading was super mushy and the chicken was gross. Now the food we just picked up isn't cooked all the way. But hey....mistakes happen and we have loved this place so I was willing to let it go and just get my money back on the last order. Because now mistakes are happening way too often.

This is the best when it comes to Pasta and Fish.  First time there and we sat in the bar.  Good service and no one does it better.  I'll definitely be back.  If you are passing through Reno and you only have time for one meal then Johnny's must be that one. Try the cod!

A great date spot. Walk down the stairs and past the heavy grey velvet curtains and you are transported into a swanky vaulted dining room with Frank Sinatra type songs being piped in at just the right level. The quality of the food was excellent and we enjoyed the family style aspect of sharing. We had the meatballs, the buffalo mozzarella, the boar bolognese, the salmon and the chicken parm. All the portions were generous with the exception of the salmon. Although the flavor of the salmon was great it was a very small portion. I enjoyed the 10th and Tasker cocktail. One star taken off f this review due to the pushiness of our waitress.  She was strongly encouraging us to do the tasting menu or to order at least 6 to 9 items for the table. She also told us rather than ordering appetizers first and then the main dishes that we had to put our entire food order in at the same time. When I am out to eat I don't like a lot of rules and being told what I can and can't do so it was a real turn off.  Despite her suggestion, we ordered a total of 5 things for the table and it was more than enough food. In fact we had a lot of leftovers. I would come back I just hope that management tells the wait staff to tone it down a bit.

Great food and even better customer service.  Went in to pick up our food only to find out they accidentally gave it away to another Amy.  They remade the food as quickly as possible and then comped my bill by 50%.  This was even after I left because they were super busy!!!  Will highly recommend if you are in downtown Indianapolis!!  Great atmosphere too!!

Typical Chinese buffet, great sushi bar, mediocre dumpling selection. The different chickens (coconut, General tso's, peppered, etc all 3.5/5 stars, some were over cooked, or sauces were too watery but it's a buffet everything can't be perfect right!!?? I appreciated the sushi bar most that's what I came for. I didn't have any noodles, soups or rices I just wanted my $15 worth of sushi tbh . I did however try their crab legs and went heavy on my plate, the one time I'm first in line and wish I was the last !! They were horrible, literally taste like refrigerator, or dish rag!! And the "butter" was literally just Oil they didn't even try to fake it!! I'd come back for the sushi (no upset stomach, cramping or anything it was ok guys) but nothing else....check out my pic of that rice pudding, I was hoping it was a joke, It was like milk and rice .

Side Bar: I hate when people don't control their children!! You know when your child is a bad*ss or has no manners just make their plate for them !! Kids were a mess running around bumping ppl my soy sauce was 1mm from being bumped on my clothes... not the establishments fault but Damn!

Been on the hunt for the best local joint, and while this is a bit more of a drive than we'd like, this is absolutely going to be our go-to spot for classic pizza.

We ordered a boardwalk pizza with sausage and they did the sausage just like the boardwalk does (and we all mean Manco & Manco or Mac's when we say boardwalk pizza, right?!). It was delicious to say the least! 

We also ordered an arancini ball.... I would like ten more please. Enough said.

And after having the most bland mozzarella sticks ever from a different place, having Brooklyn's mozzarella sticks was much needed. So much flavor in the breading AND the sauce. Not just a plain tomato-y marinara. THANK YOU.
Food quality if just plain bad. My ordered consisted of a Ceasar Salad, Chicken Piccata, Eggplant Parmesan.

This would have been my 1st time patronizing this business..I was looking forward to trying them until  the rude ass who answered the phone took my order. The tone in her voice was very idgaf-ish, she was mumbling and acted like it pained her to repeat what I didnt understand. After that I'm like ef it they're not getting my money, it's a shame good businesses miss out on getting customers because their employees have stank attitudes..maybe I'll try the castleton location..
Really yummy food and great service! This restaurant is a great value as well - large portions and fresh ingredients!

Unless you care a lot about ultra fresh and natural farm to table food, and are willing to pay a lot of money to eat it, you shouldn't come here.  The menu is small, the portions are small, everything is expensive, and the food is ultra natural.  For example, I got the shrimp and grits and the shrimp still had their heads and everything still attached which would normally be removed.  It's your choice if you want to eat it like that.  I also ate a dish that featured parts of a pig and cow that are normally discarded when eating.  I don't think it tasted very good.  I'm giving it a 2/5 because some people may enjoy this style of food but most people won't, especially after paying the high prices charged here.

Always get extra unasked for toppings in my salad but not even the worst part. As I am throwing out my food one of the employees yelled at me saying that there was a sign to not use that specific trash can. There was no sign at all and he was extremely rude for no reason. And while we were eating he was screaming at another employee. Seemed very unhappy with his job maybe he should find a new one

Great food and service.  The shrimp salad is one of the best salads I have ever had.  Perfect combination of flavors.  My friends had the spinach salad and fish tacos.  We all would order those choices again. Worth a stop if you are in Franklin.
Tearanie was amazing and food is out of this world. It's a definite must when you come down south.

We got the big island roll and the fried crab roll. Delicious! Fast service and our waiter was very kind to explain to me every single cooked meat option on the menu! Will definitely be coming back to try the all you can eat option someday!
Used open table for reservations and so glad I did. It was busy at 5:00! Great service. Nice wine list. The best spinach salad ever. Filet was incredible. Always a slam dunk here.

This was a pleasant surprise. Not sure how long it's been open, but I just noticed it a few months ago and we finally found a reason to go. Yummy Thai iced tea, spring rolls and pot stickers. I enjoyed my pad Thai, lots of chicken and I added the extra sauce from the appetizers. (Plenty left over for lunch the next day too!). My daughter  had the Pho and said it was very good. Really great service - friendly and quick. We will definitely be back.

Fuck this place. They don't pick up the phone. Called them 25 straight times before the top of the hour before they closed only to get a busy signal or VM every time. These won't pick up the phone until they're about to be closed. Save your money, pop in a Jacks pizza and save yourself the time before going to this douche canoe restaurant. Fuck these shit bags.

This review is also 3.5 stars like most of my reviews.

I've been coming to this location for over 20 years now.

Unfortunately, the food is not as good as it used to be.

The prices have also gone up significantly the past few years, so it's not the great bargain it used to be either.

The gyros are still good, as are the burgers, pizzas, fries, and wings.

The belly filler Cheesesteak isn't bad, but not that big, for me anyway.

We just had dinner here and we rarely have an amazing server but Kellie with an I was so incredible. She was so nice to my kids and had the drinks and sauces before we could ask. Omg I wish she was a service trainer for servers everywhere.

Great place. They're breads and sandwiches are fantastic. You WILL find a sandwich you love, and they're breads they bake in house fresh. Plus, Holt crap their house salad is amazing. I'm REALLY not a salad guy, but their house salad is the tastiest one Iv ever had- excellent dressing, and candied nuts and cranberries and fresh greens. Pay a visit

You know when someone says, "you get what you paid for?" Well, not in this case. Upon our arrival and after we were seated, one didn't need a magnifying glass to notice absolutely dirty glasses and utensils. I actually felt awkward cleaning them with a napkin. Food, well, we could have gone to WAWA and I'm not exaggerating....
Fiftieth Birthday, unfortunately, gone wrong for my husband. We could have stayed in Brooklyn and gone to  P. Luger. Sorry Fleming's I will not be returning.

Hello, generally i don't like to do reviews.. specially us that work in a kitchen.. Maybe it was a bad day..  I don't know, my daughter want it to eat, I suggested Goyitas coz I have been there before.. we walk in and the greeting was so careless..ok i can take that.. we order a chicken chimi and a beef taco.. ok .. I want to do this in a constructive advice..chimi to dried .. just with sour cream and guacamole, some lettuce and beans with cheese on top.. chicken to dried not well season inside the chimi.. taco just lettuce sour cream avocado ground beef  in a big fried flour tortilla .. ok I personally do not call this mexican food.. pls this is more like taco bell..  .. if you going to present this pls make it  with love.. if you are going to be in this business start making this better..add some sauce to the chimi, season the chicken and some nice garnish in the plate.. show the LOVE!!! you are not doing me a favor when i go eat to your restaurant.. we go because we love the flavors and the good food!! I do not care if is a 3 dollar taco!!! but make it Good!! it really make me upset.. bad customer service and on top you food is not good .. then do not cry when people don't go to your place.. specially on this days.. we order churros and ice cream and half of the ice cream is all melted at the time it  gets to the table...and the server did  see it! and don't do anything about it.. I don't care if you are the new kid in town it is just common sense.. you as owner if you go

I ordered the miso ramen to go a few months ago and it was amazing! They even have nice to go containers that are dishwasher safe. This is also one of the best boba places in the Indy area. I might not indoor dine here for a while because it's enclosed and semi small, but would definitely recommend supporting them with to go orders! They have adequate parking in the lot.
Great food. The service is really good.  The location south of clearwater is best location. The tampa locstion is a bit scary around the area.  Bread and coffee are great.

McDonalds corporate really needs to come in and investigate what's going on in this store. You always have 10-15 children working here just tapping away about their personal lives in front of all the customers and half of them just sitting at the tables not even working and just chilling with their friends. Very unprofessional. On top of that, the people at the registers are always rude, showing the customers how much they don't want to be there. I never seen one person working here have a smile on their face and always looking like as if someone just died in their family and the world was out to get them. Maybe it's just the location, but out of all the different McDonald's I have ever been to, this one is by FAR the WORST one I have ever been to and seen. Plus, they skimp out on the food, especially the fries, so don't be surprise if you see it only being half full. It's considered to be the "norm" over here. I guess they need to save every little penny they can make especially with all the children that don't actually work here to get paid for sitting around and chilling with their friends.

This was a random treasure that we found while running errands. I was greatly surprised this place way surpassed my expectations. The staff was very nice and gave us great suggestions...but the food...my Lord. The food was amazing. We adopted a vegan lifestyle for Lent and this made us feel like we are eating without restriction. If you live in Fishers and love Thai and a nice sushi combo check this spot out. I think I'm heading there after I wrote this post.

I've been dining or ordering delivery from this restaurant for several years. We often order 3-4 dishes with naan such as the chicken tikka masala, butter chicken, eggplant, palak paneer, garlic naan, onion kulcha, roti, cheese naan, and mango lassi.  We tried the chicken briyani today and it was good. Service is usually attentive and fast but today it was super slow. Large indoor and outdoor dining area.
I'd say it's the best Plainfield has to offer. Not always perfect but this is the place that the locals go. Food's all good. Servers are friendly and not too many places have outside seating.

Only rated 1 star because 0 is not an option! The staff at the eat- in service counter appeared as if they didn't want to be at work. Their attitudes were not welcoming in person nor on the phone. The staff at the pick-up counter seemed welcoming from what I could see. Anyway, I was told that our party of 6 would be an hour and a half wait so we sat in the car being that there's not much room to wait inside. Went back into the restaurant an hour later and was told they gave our table away but we would be next 6 top. This time we waited inside close to the service counter. An hour later (total of a 2 hour wait) they called another party of 6. When I inquired about it they just shrugged and didn't have an explanation, needless to say, we left without be served. This was a first and last visit for us!

The place gave me food poisoning the food was raw and uncooked the only good thing was the water I got at my own house so I do not recommend  this place to anyone unless you want food poisoning the place was bad a dont eat there

Drove quite away from home to try this place out.  Zen forest rolls were excellent, and the beef  pho the  broth was bland and  needed soy or salt the meat was thinly sliced and flavorful. Service was terrible my waitress was inattentive to her tables and we all kind of sat around wondering and waiting for her to come back to the dining area. Received my bill but didnt get a thank you or a smile from her during my entire experience, .Won't bother to come back my   general feel. It's typical small neighborhood strip Thai/ Asian restaurant with lazy servers

Where do I start! Great place has great food. We were visiting for 8 days and we ate here four times. I have a dairy allergy and they were happy to accommodate me no matter how busy they were. Manager dropped the food off to me and made sure to reassure me it was dairy free. Amazing we got to know the staff in a short four visits and loved them all. Steven was a great server and insight to Nashville's where to go places and Sean the manager was the sweetest. I'll be back once I'm back in Nash. Eat here! Give this place patronage it's worth every penny!

My review is for the burnt end sandwich: it's delicious, the meat is tender and you can definitely taste the smoky barbecue flavor.  However the bun is small. You can fit only two chunks of it. 


The chicken is tender but still maintains the firmness of the meat. Highly recommended.
 I ordered mine for takeout so they put the bun and meat separate.

Service  is great. Super friendly staff.

I love this European style coffee house. The menu is very expansive and everything sounded so good. We ordered two Turkish coffees. The presentation and coffee was very authentic. I wish I had a coffee house like this near me back home. I definitely recommend stopping by this place for a drink.
The best corn chowder ever !! I also love their sandwiches! Sooo good :) I can't wait to come back! Portions are big but they are so good just take it home !

The food and staff at Vecchio are the absolute best!! We recently had an outdoor small backyard wedding and they made the night unforgettable. The food and service was absolutely amazing and we had so many compliments from all of our guests. They were so accommodating to make our last minute plans work in a time where things tend to be more difficult. We did not have to worry about a thing as they took care of it all. We cannot thank them enough for all their work and delicious food! Buonissimo!
Consistently great food. From the pizza to the pastas to the sandwiches- never had a bad meal!

Ran in here to grab a bite towards the end of one of the Mardi Gras parades. The restaurant was clean, no wait & the food smelled amazing. 

I ordered the craw fish Mac & cheese & My cousin had the garlic butter shrimp. The crawfish Mac & cheese was great! I just wish they left It in the over for maybe a few more minutes. 

I tried one of her garlic butter shrimp & It was good just thought the portion was very small.

AVOID THIS PLACE!!! After waiting 33 minutes for 1 bowel of ramen and paying $19 for a below average meal you are better off getting microwaved ramen from Walmart, trust me it'll taste a lot better than the stuff they sell here.

Stopped in for the first time in a burger mood and saw great reviews thought I would give it a whirl!
Atmosphere is easy and enjoyable with Vid Friendly seating...little surprised with ketchup and salt/pepper shakers on the table.

Service was prompt and knowledgeable and friendly.

The Flamme Burger was cooked well and flavorful and yes was messy good.  Fries were handcut and fried well.  Had the Diablo dipping sauce which paired most excellently with the salty savory fries.

I would return and try other menu items

Eat local Shop Local Live Local JC

I'm giving this place 4 stars because while the atmosphere isn't all that, and it is an all you can eat place, they don't skimp on the sushi/rolls. It's freshly prepared with good sized portions. There's also some sort of salad bar and Chinese buffet going on too which is part of the price. I'll go again when I'm in the area.

I found this place after visiting Indianapolis and it is fairly good! The duck was tender and soft and had good flavor. The line however was fairly long and the prices are fairly expensive but they do give you a free champagne drink! I'd recommend anyone to come here if you want some good food but make sure to get a reservation!

BEST meal in NOLA! Robert fitzmaurice o'maoilriain was our server- friendly, and extremely knowledgeable- about the history of the restaurant and the menu!!! Everyone should try it once- I guarantee you will be back!!!

Such good food this place is a regular for my whole family and I.  We all live the chicken, the hummus, the falafels and basically everything is so tasty.   You can't go wrong with anything in their menu.  They recently spruced up and simplified the menu.

There is quite a history to this place. It really is no longer all that great, but there is something I really like about it. Service runs the gamut from very friendly to tearfully sad. The food is standard diner fare,

At first glance, Mother's (world's best baked ham) Restaurant looks like a hole in the wall.  This is the cup of joe and an egg sammich joint of Humphrey Bogart movie fame. The staff is stationed behind an old timey stainless steel counter, and you can see various offerings, including their signature ham behind glass sneeze guards. Our first hint that everything wasn't as it appeared was the long line of employees seemingly loitering back there. In truth, to call Mother's a hole in the wall is a stretch, unless your typical hole in the wall includes a long back area, which also opens onto a space that looks a little like an airplane hanger. There's room, and apparently, it's needed. This call was made for us by some of our very favorite people, B and H (because we value privacy), who were down in NOLA, where apparently drinks were consumed and breakfast was required. What came out of that experience was initial contact with the famous MEAT sandwich. There are a few iterations of this specialty, and as of this writing, I'm not sure which one was sampled, though I'm inclined to think it might have been the Ferdi. The straw that stirs this particular drink is what the menu describes as "debris", the meat which falls into the pan when cooking roast beef. Janice and I headed over for an absolutely lazy (for us) breakfast at 9ish.  She ordered the Debris Po'boy, while I stuck with a traditional breakfast waffle, though it came loaded with sweet, thick peaches and syrup. In addition

Based on good brunch reviews and being in the garden district, we had to pop in. I made a reservation for the next day but upon arriving, found out it was for the following day. They were nice enough to fit us in. Everyone had to wear their mask inside which was great. I ordered fried green tomatoes as my app and shrimp and grits for my entree. Both were ridiculously good and flavorful. I was really sad i couldn't eat all of my shrimp and grits. I should have brought it back to my room! Cocktails were yummy too. We took the streetcar back to the hotel after an amazing meal. Can't wait to go back.

Love the vibe at this place. The drinks are really awesome and they offer shareable fishbowls that brought me back to my college days! We only came for cocktails so I cannot comment on the food but the drinks and service were perfect 10's! Will be back for more research!
Great service! The smoothies are delicious. I got the Jackson Drive and Dark Lucy.. 10/10 would recommend
The Food is okay, it was greasy, but the service and location is wonderful i give them a 5 in service!

Coming from Pasadena , we decided to go to this place for breakfast . Really sweet owner and her donuts and sandwiches are very good.
Great taste with a great price

YES! We are staying at a hotel nearby and ordered a 20 inch pizza and cheesecake to have delivered. They delivered right to our room and the pizza was delicious. The slices were New York style and huge. I thought the pizza was the best part of my day until I tried their homemade cheesecake. I wish I had ordered two slices because I inhaled the first one. We are ordering again tonight!

Ordered customized Lunch special: Curry with Tofu. The front desk gladly agreed to replace chicken by Tofu. The lunch comes with Egg roll and Egg fried rice. The food was steaming hot...but less flavors though. Extra star just for friendly lady at front desk.

I dined here during Covid and had made a reservation online through yelp. I don't think it was necessary but it might be helpful to avoid any wait time. The tables were all distanced and staff was extremely nice. 

We got the grilled peaches and bruschetta. Both were good, I recommend asking for a side of balsamic glaze for that extra sweet tang. The pizza we got was the butternut squash one to which we added spicy sausage. It was ok, not the best not the worst. The neighboring tables got pasta and salmon and that looked way better!

I've ordered birthday cakes from here the past two times and will definitely order again! I got the white cake with raspberry Bavarian cream and buttercream frosting. Highly recommend, their delivery service is great as well.

Calypso is a nice choice in Nashville for affordable and decently healthy fare. Unique food for the most part. Nice sized salads. The muffins are yummy and or course the chicken is great stuff. Most items can vary greatly if they're not fresh, though.

This location suffers from a bit of a death-trap entrance and bizarre one-way (kinda?) alley exit route. They have a small lot that's clumsily shared with a gym, and general visibility sucks all around. Their move to the Sylvan-Everything vicinity made perfect sense, but this spot seems awkward and forced.

During COVID-19, they've been inexplicably closed when others have still done takeout and walk-up. Makes no sense, and doesn't communicate good things about their condition as a business. They're either not hurting for cash and can afford to do this (which makes their already-affordable menu seem overpriced all of a sudden), or they're truly screwed and have no idea how to come out of the downturn, which would be a shame.
Offers the best walk-in/pickup levant food that I have had in the US. Authentic shawarma & falafel sandwiches for half the price of comparable restaurants in the area.
A face shield is not a mask. How are people thinking this is okay? Shocked that they think it's totally okay for an employee to walk around with just a face shield.
Love this place!!! I always have the same server/bartender Josue ! Ask for him! He is the best. Love the location and the live music. 1905 salad is my favvvv

SO delicious!!! Every meal I've had the privilege of eating was great. the Shrimp and grits were my favorite. I ate it so fast I forgot to take a photo. I also liked the collard green cigarillos. I also love the ambiance and the music, the cocktails are good and strong, (I love the Poison Ivy, just wish they sold Champagne by the glass). I can't wait to come back and try more of the menu.

West Ave Grill is one of my go-to places for brunch, but this was my first time coming on a weekday. We came in at around 11:30am and even with a party of 5, the wait was less than 10 minutes.  I know its much busier on Saturday and Sunday mornings but the food is well worth the wait. My absolute favorite dish here is the buffalo chicken eggs benedict- I get it literally every time. 

Today my friends got the fluffernutter french toast and the chicken and waffles, while I stuck to my usual choice. On the menu, the fluffernutter is listed under "Fancy French Toast", and it came out looking nothing short of fancy and visually pleasing (I wish I took a picture of it). I had to ask my friend for a bite and oh my gosh, it was so good that I may stray from my usual the next time that I visit. 

Service is usually good here and the location is great. There is a parking lot right behind the restaurant as well as metered street parking.

Never had an issue with this place. The owner is very nice and friendly. However today, I went in to get a pizza and crazy bread. My total was $10.28. I had a old $10 bill form 1993 that I got from my change at another store. You'd think they wouldn't care cause after all MONEY IS MONEY. But then the employee sees it and right away says "we cannot accept older bills" I was like what ! "That's very odd, I've never heard anything like that, money is money." Overall, I just told them I was not going to be doing business with them anymore and I was going to be taking my money else where.

We made a reservation for Father's Day and specifically said we needed a private room because someone in my family has health issues. They promised us we could have a private room. We drove an hour to get there and when we arrived they said we didn't think it was gonna be so busy and they refused to honor the reservation they promised us.  They weren't even sorry.  Don't count on this place for anything.

We ordered Cholita through doordash for our rainy Monday night dinner. We got the carne asada fries and 3 tacos. Just for that we spent around $40 which was kind of ridiculous. When the food arrived the fries were warm and the topping were disproportionate. Barely any steak cheese or sour cream. Loads of beans, and veggies. Fries weren't the best quality. They're crinkle cut and once they are cold you can't exactly eat anymore. I wished the jalapeños were chopped into smaller pieces. Tacos were good. Got the gringa, bbq and fish tacos. Gringa was easily the best. Anyways, we probably shouldn't have ordered loaded fries through delivery but we've been wanting to try them for some time now. Not too bad, but could have been better.

One of the best, most consistent restaurants in Tucson. A favorite of mine for breakfast, this past weekend I had the steak and eggs. Steak was perfectly cooked, eggs fluffy and full of flavor. My buddy's chilaquiles were delicious as always. I would legit eat here everyday if I could...but my wallet won't let me :(

Caution: only go here if you enjoy delicious food and delicious drinks.

Austin was fantastic!  He was able to provide guidance and inside info on the wines but never made us felt pressured to try something.  You can tell he really loves his job.  We went for 1 drink and ended up there for hours!  Can't wait to come back!

I've been coming to Abners for 60 years. I was somewhat disappointed this visit. Service was great as usual. The family style bread was ok, the beans tasty, but the baked potato was nothing special this visit. My t-bone, requested medium rare, was over-salted and cooked medium to well done. Way over-salted. The margaritas we're overly sweetened and  weak. Outside temp was perfect. No bugs. Fairly good sized crowd for a Sunday night. Staff wore masks.

UPDATE: out of my many years going to manakeesh, I definitely had way more good experiences than bad ones. I wanted to give a better review. This is a family establishment and you can tell by the food and the quality. Every restaurant have its off days and that's ok. I will continue to be a loyal customer to manakeesh as always.

We are on a road trip home and I found this restaurant. I am glad I looked when I did because I would have hated to miss this place. We were ready for a nice break and we were greeted with a smile. We arrived and she immediately got our drink order. Monday's draft beers are $2 off. I tried a new draft and it was delicious. We arrived with three children ages 11&13. They all lived their food. The girls  got the chicken nugget meal on the kids menu and it was the perfect amount    My son got the chicken  nachos and ate about half of them. I ordered the fish tacos  and sweet potato fries and my husband got the ginger chicken sandwich. All the food was delicious  and we loved the restaurant.

Their bagels are FIRE 
I am a picky eater and for me to find this place with great food is just amazing. They sure do know what to combine on their bagels. Keep it up. I'm just a visitor in town but if ever come back...this cafe is definitely on my list! 
Great Job! 
I DIG IT
Slow service. Staff move like snails. No matter how full or empty, expect to wait forever. Horrible.

Reading the reviews from 2014 are still useful for this restaurant. I ordered room service twice. Got the food in a reasonable time frame both times. 

First night I ordered chicken parm. Got it and the first thing I went for was a bite of pasta. While twirling my pasta onto my fork the breading came off of the chicken. It was like a soggy diaper and barely any chicken under all that breading.. ‍ tasted like a can of hunts marinara sauce. And they want to charge 15$ for this

Second night. I was like okay maybe I shouldn't order pasta or anything Italian from this "Italian restaurant."
I ordered the chicken strips and a side Caesar salad. 
The salad was so wilted and I pulled brown piece after brown piece of lettuce out.  There was absolutely no crunch to the salad..the chicken strips all breading no meat. 

So moral of my story for you is go to their 24 hour cafe in the hotel. The pre-made food they have to sell is way better than any of the food I've gotten from this restaurant. ‍

Also I find this HILARIOUS..
Whoever is in charge of the restaurant will only respond to good feedback

Made it a destination for lunch yesterday and was not disappointed. Kalbi ribs are the best outside of Hawaii. The friendly service at this cozy lunch spot is off the charts as well. I will definitely be coming back for the loco moco since I use that dish as a measure of any place that offers it. Keep up the good work.

Great ambiance. 
Had the Calamari - definitely didn't disappoint from a flavor profile. Just wish the food came out hot
Wings - the wings had a great presentation but fell short with flavor. The sauce was bland and the e sprinkled pico de gallo fell short.
The entertainment had a set of country songs then "bam!" gave us a rendition of Ushers "Nice & Slow" (Nashville style of course)

Great place for drink or social meet up.

I love my Chipotle burritos but I have had to stop going to this restaurant - Why? Because even though there are signs at the entrance saying the county requires face masks because of the Covid-19 pandemic, customers are allowed in without them. Not just to pick up an order from the cashier, which would be quick and maybe not that much of a risk to everyone else, but to stand in line and then at the counter a foot away from the almost completely unprotected food prep area. Florida has emerged as the top hot spot for this pandemic in the last few weeks, setting new records almost every day. If people want to ignore that and kill themselves, great, go for it. But I'm not willing to die because of their stupidity, and because of Chipotle's lax and irresponsible behavior.

This hamburger joint is amazing!!!my food was on time my waitress Tina was in amazing person smiling checking up on us make sure we didn't need anything else 
Nice place for dinner. The two burgers we got were pretty tasty. It is a little pricey but what's new in Reno these days, unfortunately. Had a ton of menu options, other than just burgers. Could have used more tater tots with the meal, but that's a minor gripe. Unique vibe inside. I would recommend.  Especially if you get Tina as waitress

I've come here for good Viet food for years. Always solid food at great prices! The spring rolls are so crispy and crunchy with great filling. I've been to a lot of Asian restaurants and I think Pho Xe Lua has the best.

One thing I was sad about is that they no longer serve alcoholic beverages (cocktails were so good!), but it is BYOB if you want a drink with your food on a weekend night.

Love this Mexican place, especially for happy hour. $20 for a margarita pitcher! The nachos and tacos are also delicious. Only been here twice but plan to go for happy hour again. 

Cash only though.

I got to say after all the hype about this place on Facebook, I had to give it a try, they are supposedly known for the Buffalo chicken cheesesteaks, there was no blue cheese on it that I could taste, the fries were so greasy they fell out of the bag, there was three ketchup bottles outside and all three were bone dry empty, couldn't go inside for more because it was a bit windy and I was afraid my stuff would blow away, I was not impressed, place was dead also

Ok so if you saw my original review you know how under impressive this establishment was last year. Well I tried it again this past Saturday and was blown away, huge portion and the fish was fresh and didn't smell, best of all I didn't feel sick afterwards. It was so good I actually got the same thing the very next day. I don't know what was wrong with this place last year( well, everything was actually) but way to turn the ship around. I got a bowl with two proteins, salmon and tuna , with rice volcano sauce pineapple avacado and bunch of other stuff. I ordered the same exact thing two days in a row and it was consistently perfect. Kudos guys keep it up

Apparently I've never reviewed Shoefly before, which is strange since I've been going since they opened. Everything is delicious. The potato fries with the garlic Parmesan toss will change your world. I've never had a bad dessert there, and the drink selection is great. 

With all the struggles for restaurants during this pandemic, they have added groceries for pickup as well. They have a great selection, including things I wasn't able to find in stores a couple weeks ago. The pickup process is easy and the food quality is outstanding.

Such great food, enjoyable ambiance, attentive staff!!!! Love this place!  Reminds me of my Italian grandmothers food, it's so delicious.  I feel like the menu options are changing, they are always trying something new or different and they nail it every time!  It's a great spot if you are looking for a place to just enjoy, company, food and drinks!!!! They also do catering and you can rent the room there too, which makes it super convenient.  I used it for my baby shower and it was perfect!

Stopped in for lunch today. First time. Staff were very nice and very helpful. DH had broccoli beef which he said was delicious (I snuck a bite and agree). I had house Lo Mein which was full of meat, tender noodles, and veggies. Just the the right amount of sauce and spice. We also shared Dumplings and spring rolls....delish!!  We will DEFINITELY be going back.

This place is up there with places like donut friend in LA & Donut plant in NYC. They also have a burger made with a glazed donut. I didn't eat that but it sure looked appetizing with tomatoes, avocado & hot steaming burgers. The hot dogs are served in a brioche bun not a basic hot dog bun. The fries are unbelievably delicious even after they get cold & hard you'll still finish every last bite!

I was very surprised by the quality and the quantity of the food. It was delivered very warm I ordered a custom medium pizza the cheese bread and wings wings were nearing and very good the pizza had plenty of toppings no skimping there and the crust (thin) was crisp and flavorful

When in town this is my go to place every Thursday night. Great sushi great, happy hour specials, usually a live band and great. service provided by Spencer and Donny! I remember when Rashada and Sushi Inc has kept the high quality! Very easy and close to everything in downtown ST Pete!
We only stopped for a beer here, but the food looked great, and it was a fun environment!! Will have to go back when we are hungry.

Went to Turning Point-Bryn Mawr for brunch on a Saturday.  Overall, the service and food were just ok.  We ordered omelette dishes, which were just ok.  This is the third Turning Point location I've tried.  Compared to locations in South Jersey, the restaurant was less busy during weekend brunch hours and the staff seemed less friendly.

Holly Mac & Cheese!!! 

We happened to unintentionally stumble upon this place and I'm sooooooooooo happy I did!! It was right next door to a hookah spot that we went to and of course this was the best way to end the night. If every night ended with Mac & Cheese (especially by Mac Mart)... life would be PERFECT!!!

Speaking of perfect, I need to address Mac Mart's ability to stand out as a business. Taking something as simple ass mac & cheese and mastering the product is exceptionally genius. Their appearance is on point and very clean. Their packaging is spectacular. I love having the little container to go and be able to reuse it for other purposes. Also, their customer service is remarkable. 

We were only in there for about 10 minutes. I decided to go with the Crabby Mac, which was delicious. A homeless man walked in and was disturbing the peace. But the girls that worked there were very alert and asked the man to leave right away. Then checked on all the customers to make sure everyone was okay. I found that this situation spoke volumes. Made me feel safe and their customer service left a great impression on me. I can't wait to come back for more mac & cheese!!

Great service during the lockdown. Could tell they really appreciated our order. It came very promptly and the food was good. They even sized up our order and added extras at no cost. The food was all what we ordered and it was all hot and tasty. We appreciate the quality and service at this time
Love this place! Subs are amazing and fries are delicious. Can't beat it for sandwiches in town

If I was rating only the food, this restaurant would rate a five. Unfortunately, the service only rates a three.  Maybe it's the language barrier. 
The kabobs, meat or fish, are moist and flavorful. The salads are excellent.  I love the fresh herring with boiled potatoes and onions. The fresh baked bread is scrumptious.  
There's a covered veranda for outdoor seating. And it's a BYOB.  As long as you're prepared to spend at least two hours there and to have to track down your waitress to pay the check, this is a great restaurant to try.

Very good fun spot, but the food felt like it was a bit rushed. 

Will try again. But I'm still looking for that go to diner.
We have eaten in and had delivery many times since Bullseye opened and we are always pleased with the food and the service. They make a great burger :)

Seen this Mexican Restaurant pop up where the old Tiki Bar used to be on Gulf to Bay. I love a good Mexican Restaurant and was happy to see that someone cleaned up this old spot.

Came in for a late lunch on a Monday and I'm pretty sure I was greeted by the owner! Their menu is fabulous and HUGE! I decided to get a lunch  special. Warning! Portions are huge; but you totally get your monies worth. I ordered, "Lunch 1": 1 chile relleno, refried beans, 1 taco and 1 guacamole salad. The portions are extremely generous! I had to have my husband help me finish. :) 

I love how Santa Fe does their own healthy twist on traditional Mexican dishes. I was pleased that my chile relleno was stuffed with seasoned beef and cheese but was in a red sauce and not in a fatty cream sauce. There was no grease! My taco (you choose hard or soft) was classically the best; no B.S.. Just a hard shell taco, lettuce and cheese. All this food for only $6.50!!!! 

Since we already were calling it a day, my husband and I took advantage of their Happy Hour Margarita Pitcher for $15! The margaritas were amazing! They hit just right, refreshing and not overly sweet. They were well made.

The inside is beautifully decorated with Mexican artwork and is extremely clean. They play "Spanish" music but more modern like Selena. The service was friendly and polite.

What are you waiting for?! Get to Santa Fe now! Finally a real family owned restaurant on Gulf to Bay. It's nice to see a restaurant succeed that is not

Came here for take out a month or so back so I could properly get roast beef sandwiches again.

Really, really good. We got both roast beef and roast pork sandwiches. 

Fries were good even the next day, it may have been the roast beef wrapper they were in.

If you've never been, check it out. When you're able to dine in, I recommend getting the roast beef with horseradish and fries with beef gravy. It's terrific.

Love this place! So much to see aside from the restaurant. Read more about Traders Point. Food is always FRESH - usually from the farm. Fried green tomatoes, yes. Even their burger is amazing. Biscuits and gravy or Shrimp and grits are the go to for breakfast. I've not had anything that I didn't really enjoy. After dinner - espresso affogato or any of their homemade desserts - ice cream here is a must.

Good flavored lattes, cool space. I have to say the music that tends to be on is pretty bad. Just droning indie that is too loud and makes it harder to have a conversation. I think an edit here would be appreciated by all. 

Their food is hit or miss. Gluten free savory crepe was lame, my friend threw it out. Maybe they don't make it often enough. I had the Italian panini sandwich that was ill-described. It had thick slices of thanksgiving style ham on it and was on lightly toasted bread, no way that sandwich saw the inside of a panini machine. I was expecting a hot Italian sub taste on panini bread. I've had the nutella crepe before and that was good.

Prime rib au jus sandwich (French dip in other words).

Shaved meat - nope.  Just cust into slices.

"Au Jus" - nope.  Nothing.

Wow I'm so excited to pay $80 (including delivery) to get a dry sandwich with oversized meat slices (not shaved), no choice of salad dressing... oh I can't go on.

Sam, your team needs replacement.  They don't give a hoot about the food or the customer.

Ehud
P.S. I'm not going to attach photos of cold large meaty pieces.  If you want to see it -- just order from Culinary Dropouts (that's who work there, right?)
Excellent food and service. First visit here, and definitely won't be our last. My sister even liked the home fries, and she's never liked home fries in a restaurant since at least 2005. Great job!

We came by and tried the savory sunshine waffle and the sweet Strawberries and cream. They were very fun to try and tasted very good. They have self serve coffee also. They have a wide variety of choices for flavors of both the sweet and savory.  You can also watch them make the waffles. The kitchen is very open. 
We would come by as a novelty, but probably not frequent unless we had company or just wanted something different.

I really wish I would have checked the reviews before booking this hotel in Santa Barbara. The hotel itself is not bad but the rooms are very small and stuffy. We had a beach view which is more of a pool view and since it's on the first floor it's also an invitation for all at the pool to look into your room. There was limited service at the pool due to Covid and the bartender was not very skilled at bar tending ... super nice but not a bartender.. more a drink pourer into a cup guy. I asked for a Frose which I was told at 11 am would not be done by 2pm.. and it really wasn't until 2:30. My sangria was not very good and I gave up on ordering drinks. Food was good but they didn't have ranch dressing, ran out of guacamole and had a very limited menu. The closest restaurant is about a 25 minute walk so you really limited on options here. The guy upstairs fell asleep with his music full blast so I was treated to a concert in my room until 5am which was when the front figured out where the noise was coming from. Walls super thin I discovered. Plumbing is not the best here too. The room did have charming Spanish decor but I wouldn't pay to come here again.

This place has been great for so many years. They are doing curbside service during this tough time. I just picked up a pan of lasagna, amazing!  It was like $2 a portion, what a deal. I've met the family that owns it, they all work there. They are so nice, feels good to support a great owner that treats customers like family.

After tonight's meal, I am updating this to a 5 star. I had the best gnocchi of my life. The drinks, app, entrees and desserts tonight were all outstanding. The service is always good, but tonight it was impeccable for a busy Saturday. Keep it up F&F, you guys are doing it right!!

The poke here was delicious! On the top of all variety of protein choices, they mixed the protein and added-on, and sauce in separate bowl before poured over to base.  For sauce , she asked me if I like light ,medium or heavy -such a good idea so the bowl won't be too salty or too sweet. it's the way of fine tuning to customers' personal tastes.The kale noodle was very good, The topping I really like was the  fried lotus root . It was crunchy , tasty and looked cool. I was amazed to see that there was  a machine making sushi burrito. An employee inserted a piece of seaweed into the machine and it rolled out with the sushi rice laying neatly on top of the seaweed paper. Next step they just had to put the protein of choice at the center and roll up the sushi burrito. Such a wonderful machine! They also offered different kind of drinks.  I didn't get them this time and they looked quite attractive. The service was good. Only couple tables for eat- in but no problem grabbing the bowl and eat at the mall food court.  This shop  is such a positive addition in the International Mall.  Next time when I'm at the neighborhood I will come back for more poke.
This is an amazing choice for catering events.  You will not be disappointed. We have chosen Maggiano's annually for several years because they are reliable as well as very delicious.
The Italian subs are awesome. Bread is so good. They have 4 sizes of subs. Perfect for a picnic or the beach.

This place has gone downhill fast. First thing the waiters and bus boys are the most friendly people out there. Was my favorite since it was one of the three or four restaurants in the north valleys. No more dinner hours, even on the weekends. No more prime rib and they even took the nachos off the menu which were the best nachos in reno. Not sure if they got new owners but if so they made some bad decisions. Probably not going to return. Was my all time favorite local place to get food but not anymore.

This was my second time visiting Country Donuts and it's safe to say, they've got a fan! The first time I visited was a home run- great service, fantastic selection, delicious donuts. This time, the same experience, only it was taken to the next level by the way the 2 ladies working behind the counter professionally handled the man with his 2 kids who blatantly ignored the prominently displayed masking regulations. As I sat in my car this morning, I wondered how it would be handled. I saw the man become increasingly animated as he was told he would need to either wear a mask or leave (as I found out later). He decided to storm out, sans delicious donuts, leaving more for us mask wearing citizens. Thank you to the 2 ladies behind the counter for your part in trying to maintain standards and keep everyone safe. Your act of bravery was seen and noticed. Please keep up the great work and great donuts.

Wanted to try something new since we had a gift card. Ordered through DoorDash, which said 60 minute delivery. No problem. The poor Dasher ended up waiting for the order for more than an hour!  Our meal was ordered at 5:20 and showed up at 7:10.  And the food was pretty terrible. We started with the chicken satay, which was tasteless and dry.  Also ordered two rolls. They were OK, but other places in the area are much better. Especially given the long wait time.  Check this one off the list.  Won't be back.

We had heard about this spot a couple times and decided to get Takeaway one Saturday afternoon. We called in the order and it was ready relatively quickly, which impressed me as there was an activity at Bankerslife Fieldhouse going on so they were busy.

They have a wide variety of options but we went with the vegetable choice. I must say I wasn't expecting a lot as often it can be more bread and cheese than veggies. This was a splurge for me to have the cheese and I hoped it was worth the choice. When we bit into it not only was it deliciously warm and gooey, but it was packed full of veggies! Plus it wasn't overly full of cheese but instead had a lot of great sauce and a mix of all ingredients.

The other notable thing was that the calzone was huge! I determined to eat all of mine because it was so tasty and delicious, but honestly next time it might be better to split one.

This is a great little casual spot with something filling and not too expensive if you're headed to an event downtown, or just want to pick up something to go. Yum! Worth it!

I love Empty Bowl! Everything I've ordered from there is delicious and The portions are huge so you will definitely need a container to go unless you're extremely hungry. Service is great and even though it's a small area people wait in line for a reason because it's delicious!!!

Great service, drinks and appetizers. Our table had oysters, the cauliflower tahini and jumbo crab toast, which were all fantastic. For entrees, we had the the wagyu, which was too salty and branzino, which was dry. Overall I would return for apps and drinks, but not entrees.

Had a great time at Kick Axe on Saturday.  Bartenders Sean and Chris were great an accommodating (extensive XFL knowledge) and Axe Master April was engaging and funny.

This is a more upscale, premium axe throwing experience with food and beverage available for purchase as opposed to the BYO places.  Will definitely go again!

I stopped here tonight to pick up dinner after working late. I had heard that they had Loco Moco, which I have always wanted to try. The owners were super nice. I ordered the Loco Moco and fried gyoza. The gyoza were delicious and so was the Loco Moco. Included with my dinner was hibachi vegetables and macaroni salad. I really only like homemade macaroni salad, and I was really happy when I realized it was indeed homemade, and very good! Loco Moco is kind of like a Hawaiian blue plate special and always includes macaroni salad, a bed of rice with gravy on top, then two hamburger patties and fried eggs on top of that. I've been to Hawaii twice and never had it there, but I've read lots about it and know how it should be served! I have to say that it was everything that I was hoping for. Oh...I saw a previous review that said the hamburgers weren't seasoned enough for them, I found them to be seasoned exactly as I like. The portions were big, a lot of bang for your buck as I like to say! I couldn't even finish the whole thing, lol. I highly recommend Hawaiian BBQ and I can't wait to try some of the other dishes on the menu. It's Christmas season right now and I work a lot of hours and don't have time to cook unless I have a day off which isn't very often during the holidays, so I'm always happy to find a place that is open late enough(they're open until 9:30pm), not expensive, and has good food. I will definitely be back frequently!

We had an excellent take out lunch.  The price provided good value.  We each had a lasagna, one traditional and the other spinach chicken.  The lunch came with a salad accompanied by homemade peppercorn ranch.  Two small pieces of garlic bread as well.  Our only regret is we are not staying in Boise a little longer to try other menu options.

Love the set-up of this place

Happened to be walking by looking for a place to have lunch and had decent drinks. 

Well they had a nice assortment of beers which you're able to get at 4oz and even make a flight out of a few. 
The aroma coming from this place had my mouth watering and praying that it was worth it. And it was...I wasn't disappointed at all. 
We ordered the Wings which were cooked perfectly and had enough sauce on the wings. As my main meal I ordered the BBQ Pulled Pork sandwich and really enjoyed it. There were 4 homemade sauces on the table that I was able to add to my sandwich. I switched out the regular fries for the sweet potato fries and was glad I did. The waitress even had our meal separated for us since we were sharing a meal. 

There were several TV's behind the bar with several different games on. 

Our server was attentive and helpful with my beer selections and the restaurants favorites. 

I will defiantly be returning!!!

This is one of the best spots to have good creole food in the whole of New Orleans.  Kids meal portions are substantial, the Shrimp remoulade with fried green tomatoes are amazing!  Crawfish etouffe also the best I've tasted so far.

If the Corona Virus had a taste it would be the Super Burrito. Please use social distancing from this dissapointment. It was like expecting the zombie apocalypse and getting all of the bars shutdown instead.

I honestly nearly missed this place! Thank goodness for Google maps, because I didn't see the name on the outside anywhere (or even the street numbers, but maybe I missed them in the dark). Nice looking inside, with the bar/ dining area and an upstairs. Cozy. 

The hush puppies were good. Not the best I've ever had, since I tend to prefer warmer and crisper, but would happily munch on them if placed before me. The fried chicken sandwich was better than expected actually. It wasn't too heavily breaded and the breading was fried such that it wasn't soggy and didn't easily slip off the meat, which was nice. Not too spicy that it took away from actually being flavorful, and the dab of coleslaw added a nice contrast. 

I think they're more known for their oysters and such, so while what I had was good, I wasn't blown away, but I think that's maybe on me.
This is the worst McDonald's around. I have never gotten my complete order. The people that work here don't care about anything and are incompetent.

Although I've lived 2 minutes from Paul's, I hadn't eaten there until almost 2yrs.  
Ordered the "House" Pizza and wings.
The pizza was delicious and the wings were crispy and cooked to perfection, best I've ever tasted.
I was so appreciative I had to call back and let them know how great there food was. 
In these times where restaurants are struggling to stay open, I think a generous tip and deserved accolades are good for moral! They were delighted to hear back from a very satisfied customer/neighbor.  Thanks Paul's Chicago Pizza.
I look forward to ordering other items from there interesting menu!
Rose Jamieson
Underwhelmed.. cold chicken, undercooked salmon and a HUGE bone in the chicken salad..Go anywhere else.. sterile, plastic knives and forks...

Lolo's is so masarap (delicious)! I fell in love with Filipino food when I was a teenager and was able to visit Philippines a few years ago, trip courtesy of the woman who my daughter gave her 2 kidneys to when she donated her organs 9 years ago (#Donatelife).  Filipino food makes me so happy! I had no idea Lolos was here until I saw a Facebook post,  SO happy I did! The owners Lorry and Bill are so friendly! The food was amazing,  had me hooked at first bite and makes me reminisce of my trip to Philippines and my love for their food at each bite.  My children loved the BBQ pork too! The special had all the food I love, especially my favorite Pancit and Lumpia!!! I'll be back as often as I can to help support this new business! Can't wait to dine in also!
A MAZE ING!!!!! That's all I can say!! That was the most amazing seafood meal I've ever had!!!
order a 12 clams and i got bottle clams very small not worth the money. bloody Mary's were not good no flavor or spice to much ice as well...

Over 100 reviews and five stars?? I was skeptical, but I get it now. Merengue Cafe was exactly what my friends and I needed today. It was rainy and dreary, and we were all hungry. The restaurant is clean and cheery, the staff is attentive, friendly and incredibly helpful. The food is LEGIT. A delightful taste of the Caribbean. I sampled a little bit of everything because I couldn't decide and I wasn't disappointed. Their rice and peas/beans are delicious! Order from the buffet and get your food right away. Order from the back and it'll take about 15-20 minutes but it's worth the wait. We had a party of six plus two children and the atmosphere was great. We'll be back.

While waiting for our truck to get finished at dealership we came here for lunch. Had our two dogs with us and they gave us a great outdoor table with shade for the dogs and big bowls of ice water for the dogs. We orders fish tacos and tri-tip tacos. Omg by far the best tacos we've ever had.   The service was amazing, the atmosphere is awesome and the food is to die for. Highly recommend this joint
Bf ordered orange chicken which was really good, I ordered dragon and Phoenix (gen Tsos and shrimp w veggies) and the shrimp was really overcooked.

We were in from out of town, and chose this restaurant based on its good Yelp reviews, and I'm so glad that we did! Everything here was top notch. The food itself is all fresh, made from scratch, and full of flavor. We loved the coleslaw, mac and cheese, potato salad, and pickles. I'm sure we would have loved the other sides too, these were just the ones that we tried. The meat was also delicious, and super tender (perfectly cooked in my opinion). If we ever find ourselves back in town we'll make our way here for sure! We were even treated to complimentary moon pies after our meal. Our family of four all loved this restaurant, and would highly recommend it!!
We have done inside dining and takeout, pre and post covid. Always good food and service

Had some awesome takeout for lunch here. The hot panang curry was decently spicy. We also got the padsee-ew with beef, which was great. Both lunch specials came with rice and a little spring roll (with dipping sauce). Online ordering was quick and a easy. I can tell that we'll be frequent guests here.

The hostess was very friendly when I arrived. I loved the beautiful interior with fountain and fish tank. Can't wait to dine in once covid dies down.

Delicious food, easy ordering and pickup. It's a shame I've never had the opportunity or pleasure to eat in but I will be sure to return. The lamb korma was tasty & decadent and engaged all my senses. The lamb saag was spicy, as ordered. It was phenomenal and the kick snuck up so miraculously at the end. The naan keema was versatile & flavorful. I am happy to see Indian cuisine readily available in Jenkintown; don't miss out, folks!

This restaurant took very good care of me on what was my first visit. While I could not have my first choice due to an allergen concern, I had the cali wrap with chicken. Absolutely fresh and delicious! As an added bonus, I was able to have the Cesar side dressing as they use vegan mayo as a base (the dressing itself is not vegan but does not contain egg). 
Also the rice and beans on the side was delicious. 
Hats off to the staff for taking care of me and for providing a great meal.

Yay how amazing the Napoleon house was open when I visited the French quarter. I had the most amazing salad and their new frozen Pims cup, All to go of course. But it was really nice because the French quarter was really clean and quiet and we walked over to the river and sat on a bench and ate our lunch. There were a few shops open so it was kind of nice feeling like we had the French quarter all to ourselves.

I've been to this spot twice in the past month of visiting Tampa. The first time I had the Pho Dac Biet with high hopes. I was craving something warm and with broth, so I figured this would be a perfect fit.

I was slightly disappointed when it came out though. There were no cilantro and green onion garnishes, as per usual. Not too much meat and the broth was oddly sweet. It definitely kept me thirsty, even after the meal.

The second time was a bit more redeeming. I ordered the vermicelli bowl loaded with eggrolls, grilled shrimp and pork. I was so excited to see how much toppings they gave, they definitely didn't skimp on anything. It came with a sweet fish sauce on the side, to add to your liking. If I came back, I would get this again.

Without question... the best tomato pie you can get within X number of square miles.  If you're a real PRO.... make sure you order the Tuesday ONLY Tomato Pie special.... A1 provolone + the homemade sauce is 1/1... just special and you couldn't duplicate this stuff!  

Pizzas are great across the board... sandwiches... sides... etc.  If you're in the area... this is a no brainer

This was our first time visiting the city, and we have heard great things about this place. It definitely lived up to the standards!! Wonderful staff, everyone was super friendly and helpful when it came to deciding what we wanted. We built our own calzone, and it came out in around 10 min, which is pretty quick! Also clean inside. Would definitely recommend  the portion was huge, and was great for us to split between the two of us.

We are in the middle of the pandemic. There are a lot of restaurants closed and I had a craving for Chinese cuisine. I just drove around and stumbled upon this place. I called the place and ordered over phone and waited. The lady was doing a good job of politely delegating social distancing, encouraging customers to stay away from each other. Once again, we are in hard times and she was polite. 
Anyway, I ordered the basics, spicy general gso's and mild sesame chicken. The General Gso's wasn't very spicy but everything had a good flavor. Fried crab Rangoon had a unique spin, but I liked it. You either love it or hate it, I would get it again. It was better the next day when I reheated them. Shrimp rolls & pork rolls couldn't have been better. They were bigger than the average takeout spot. Pork fried rice was ok but something was unusual with the darker color. Maybe a seasoning. I would Order everything again. As a matter of fact, I probably will within the week.

Went for some stone crab- holy moly our server was INSANELY slow and inattentive at every turn. Didn't want to be rude and hunt him down for refills or lemons or etc, but I felt like I wasted most my meal waiting for him. I've been a server and work in hospitality for years and I get when things are busy, but dang- he was just slow as molasses without any sort of care- and they weren't busy. Plus he spilt beer all over my purse and barely batted an eye.

I'm obviously in the minority, but I just thought this place was ok. To be fair, I only had the pizza delivered, so maybe it'd have been better there. 

The pizza was fine. I have no real complaints. But absolutely nothing was memorable. The menu wasn't super exciting. There didn't seem to be a ton of options. 

Nothing bad. But nothing to go out of my way for.
